model.name: State-file currency — boot-currency guard covers agent state files (context.md/learnings.md) by structural discovery, not just boot.md
model.description: Extend the boot-currency guard (R40.55) to agent STATE files (context.md/learnings.md), not just boot.md — the SAME blind-side as check:pin-single-source: the boot-currency lint globs boot.md ONLY, so a stale STATE file outside the scan walks past (a deprecated bare <role>/context.md nearly false-flagged ARON). Activates the deferred PO-D5 context-anchor-currency debt. PRINCIPLE (from the boot arc): BOOTS get removal (rot-PROOF); STATE files MUST carry state -> only rot-EVIDENT. So the lint does NOT demand freshness; it asserts the properties that make a stale state file self-evidently a starting-point AND stop it being READ AS CURRENT. STRUCTURAL scope (no governance judgment): the ACTIVE/read set = every state file a boot.md points at (via its Context:/Deep-files: pointer) -> gate RED; DORMANT orphans (no boot points at them) = WARN-latent, never CI-RED (delta-vs-absolute). oosh-* shadows route through the EXISTING /^oosh-/ EXCLUDED predicate (reuse R40.55, WARN-loud, never our CI-RED).

discoverySource.trigger: a deprecated bare <role>/context.md nearly false-flagged ARON; boot-currency lint globs boot.md ONLY so a stale state file walks past
discoverySource.trainerEmphasis: the DIVERGENCE CHECK is THE core assertion: discover by STRUCTURE not a type-list; new-KIND-not-enrolled => RED; stub seeds a NEW-KIND file

model.activatesDebt: R40.55 contextAnchorCurrencyDebt (PO D5) — the cure moved rot boots->anchors (rot-EVIDENT not rot-proof); this req is that debt ACTIVATED for the state files.
model.scopeNote: ACTIVE/read set = boot-Context-pointer targets => CI-RED. DORMANT orphans (no boot points at them, the ~60 Feb-May set) = WARN-latent, never CI-RED (delta-vs-absolute). oosh-* shadows = EXISTING /^oosh-/ EXCLUDED predicate (reuse R40.55, WARN-loud, coordinate, never our CI-RED).

model.crossRefNote: THE R40.55 boot-currency guard extended to state files (D5 debt activated). Same enumerate-not-universal+completeness recursion-closure as R40.54. Reuses R40.55's /^oosh-/ EXCLUDED predicate + structuralDiscover principle. Trainer propagates the marker convention + verify-don't-trust preface; architect re-inspects post-propagation.

acceptanceCriteria.text: SHADOW single-source (the sharp hazard): a role with BOTH <role>/context.md AND <role>@<host>/context.md = TWO sources for one agent (measured pairs: agent-trainer, oosh-architect/expert/po/tester). The boot defaults toward the BARE name. The bare-name file MUST be absent, OR a DEPRECATED-pointer to the live one, OR itself current. A stale-unmarked bare shadow a boot defaults to => RED (two-source-of-truth disease; cure = retire/deprecate the second, never keep two live).

gateRef.assertion: a boot-pointed BARE <role>/context.md stale while <role>@<host>/context.md is live, no deprecated marker => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: seed a stale unmarked bare <role>/context.md while the @host one is live (the ARON near-miss) -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: ROT-EVIDENT shape (PO D5, now enforced): a boot-pointed ACTIVE state file MUST carry the verify-don't-trust anchor preface (the '⚠ DO NOT TRUST — re-derive via git… + otmux pane.self' head). Missing it = the file asserts itself as current-truth = the rot hazard => RED. Makes every active state file rot-EVIDENT (a stale file cannot be read as current).

gateRef.assertion: every boot-pointed active state file carries the verify-don't-trust preface; missing => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: seed a boot-pointed active state file WITHOUT the verify-don't-trust preface -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: DEPRECATION marker (trainer convention, propagated): a superseded/shadowed state file carries `> ⛔ DEPRECATED <YYYY-MM-DD> -> <successor path>`. The lint asserts a shadowed/dormant file carries it AND is FAIL-CLOSED on an unparseable date — a marker with no parseable date => RED, never skip-as-ok (same fail-closed posture as the R3 resolver / boot-currency truth-source).

gateRef.assertion: a shadowed/dormant file carries a DEPRECATED marker with a PARSEABLE date; an unparseable-date marker => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: seed a deprecated marker with an unparseable date -> RED (fail-closed)

acceptanceCriteria.text: ★ THE CORE ASSERTION (trainer/PO load-bearing, NOT secondary): the ROOT blind-side was enumerating a file TYPE (boot.md) so a different KIND (context.md) hid OUTSIDE the scan. The guard DISCOVERS the agent-state-file set by STRUCTURE/GLOB — session/agents/*/context.md, */learnings.md, AND per-host */@*/… — NEVER a hand-listed type list; a state file present-on-disk but NOT in the evaluated set => RED (enumerate-not-universal + COMPLETENESS). The stub-must-fail seeds a NEW-KIND file (not merely a stale one) and proves the lint REDs on the UNENROLLED KIND — the exact property that would have caught THIS defect (same recursion-closure as R40.54: new-X-not-enrolled => RED).

gateRef.assertion: on-disk agent-state-file set == evaluated set; a present-but-unevaluated file OR a NEW file-KIND/@host-shadow => RED (never hide by being unlisted)

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING (the defining stub): seed a NEW-KIND state file (e.g. session/agents/<role>/notes.md) present-but-unevaluated -> RED on the unenrolled kind
